domain: municipal operations / weekly service-request (C3 notification) time series
prediction_question: For a City of Cape Town C3 complaint category (city-level primary formulation; suburb x category expansion), at the weekly prediction instant (Tuesday 06:00 SAST), will the number of service-request notifications CREATED in the coming 7-day window (whole SAST days Wednesday..Tuesday) exceed 1.25x the median of the trailing 8 weekly counts?
prediction_time: Tuesday 06:00 SAST (UTC+2), weekly. Publisher-documented update cadence is daily Mon-Fri with daily incremental inserts keyed on Notification ID; measured availability at 2026-10-29T08:31:51 SAST: rows created 2026-10-28 (D-1) present (3,853 rows), rows created 2026-10-29 (same day) not yet present. Features therefore use created-dates through Sunday (D-2, guaranteed posted by Monday's update); the target window (created-dates Wed..Tue) begins the day after the instant's day, so no part of the target window precedes the prediction instant and no target-window row is queryable at the instant. CreatedOnDT carries day granularity only (SAP DD.MM.YYYY), which is why whole-day windows are used.
target_definition: Binary surge label: 1 iff created-notification count for the (category [, suburb]) unit in the target window Wed..Tue exceeds 1.25x the median of that unit's counts for the 8 weeks ending before the prediction instant. Label source columns: CreatedOnDT (created date) with C3_Complaint_Type (and Suburb for the expansion); target-window rows are excluded from every shipped feature. Post-hoc columns (ChangedOnDT, CompletedDT) and the monthly-reconciled Suburb_Clean for weeks inside the reconciliation lag are excluded as features; Suburb_Clean backfill lag measured at 9.0% NULL pre-2026 vs 46.5% NULL for rows created since 2026-09-01.

sources.licence: City of Cape Town Open Data License per the item description; Open Data Terms of Use page is disclaimer-only (no reuse restriction); Council-approved Open Data Policy 27781 defines the data as freely used, shared and built-on (see license_evidence)

license_evidence: Open Data Policy, Policy Number 27781, revised and approved by Council 03 December 2020 (https://www.capetown.gov.za/media/vg2plaql/open_data_policy.pdf, read 2026-10-29), Definitions: "'Open data' means data that can be freely used, shared and built-on by anyone, anywhere, for any purpose."

Same policy, clause 7.1.5: "Access to open data will be free by default. The widespread use of data for innovation will be encouraged..."; clause 7.6: "The use of the Open Data Portal will be subject to its Terms of Use. The Terms of Use will conform with open data principles."; clause 7.7: "Access to the Portal will be free of charge and will not require prior registration by users."; clause 7.5.3 encourages users to "contribute to or add value to City data".

City of Cape Town Open Data terms of use (https://www.capetown.gov.za/general/city-of-cape-town-open-data-terms-of-use/, read 2026-10-29): "The following terms of use apply to visitors and users of the Open Data Portal section of the City of Cape Town's website." The page contains a disclaimer (as-is, no warranty, no liability), the Esri master-agreement reference and the Open Data Policy download - it imposes NO restriction on reuse, redistribution or derivatives for the portal data.
The dataset item's own documentation (ArcGIS item da3b6d46845e4671bde500e8de7e1d3e, read 2026-10-29) states: "License : City of Cape Town Open Data License".

Counter-signal recorded for the reviewer: the general City website copyright statement (https://www.capetown.gov.za/general/terms-of-use) says "Any redistribution or reproduction of part or all of the contents in any form is prohibited" for website content - read as scoped to the general website, because the Open Data terms of use are the section-specific instrument for the Open Data Portal and the Council policy binds those terms to open data principles; the Hub page footer line "Copyright 2026 Corporate GIS, City of Cape Town. All rights reserved." is site chrome, not a dataset licence.

Residual ambiguity, recorded honestly: the publisher uses no named standard licence (no CC/ODbL instrument); the redistribution permission rests on the Council-approved policy definition plus disclaimer-only section terms. Flagged for the standing release-stage licence review (candidates/<id>/license.json); no operator risk acceptance is claimed.
licence_note: Council-approved Open Data Policy defines portal data as freely usable, shareable and buildable-on by anyone for any purpose; section-specific Terms of Use are disclaimer-only; access free and anonymous. No named standard licence - flagged for release-stage licence review.

jurisdiction.publisher: City of Cape Town (Open Data Team / Corporate GIS) - metropolitan municipality in South Africa; operational source: SAP C3 Notifications; published via ArcGIS Hub (odp-cctegis.opendata.arcgis.com)

split_strategy: Temporal weekly splits on the created-count panel: train = scorable weeks starting <= 2024-12-31 (98 weeks per category at city level), eval = 2025 (43-47 weeks), holdout = 2026 to date (43 weeks). Measured city-level surge counts (label: week > 1.25x trailing-8-week median), probe_c3.py --surge, snapshot weekly_series_5cats.json: No Power 15/98 train, 15/47 eval, 8/43 holdout; SEW: Blocked/Overflow 9/98, 6/47, 4/43; Street Lights - All Lights Out 17/98, 13/47, 9/43; Illegal Dumping 14/98, 9/43, 7/43; Damaged Bin - 240L 10/98, 9/43, 8/43 - both classes present in every window for every probed category. Positives cluster in category-level regime waves (week-level counts above are the clustered evidence). The suburb x category expansion (>=26 weeks history per unit) multiplies units by hundreds; its full counts are a construction-time measurement on the worker and are not claimed here.

measurements.panel_shape_measured: 4,509,409 notifications; CreatedOnDT day-granular 2022-12-31..2026-10-28 (196 weeks, no month gaps at week level); >1,000 distinct C3_Complaint_Type values (group-by hit the 1000-row cap); top categories measured: No Power 463,757; SEW: Blocked/Overflow 463,307; Street Lights - All Lights Out 193,973; Street Lights - Single Light Out 183,787; Damaged Bin - 240L 120,889; hygiene labels present (Duplicate 68,370; DO NOT USE (Tree Complaint) 26,081) and must be excluded from the curated category set; ~28% of rows lack coordinates (tabular item used, spatial twin not)
measurements.provenance_mix_measured: Every row is one C3 notification from the SAP C3 Notifications system (single provenance stream; no sentinel/non-sentinel mixture). Suburb_Clean NULL (unreconciled): 9.0% pre-2026 vs 46.5% for rows created since 2026-09-01 - the publisher's monthly reconciliation backfills it with a lag of weeks
measurements.publication_lag_measured: At 2026-10-29T08:31:51 SAST: created-dates through 2026-10-28 present (3,853 rows), created-date 2026-10-29 absent (0 rows); publisher-documented cadence: daily Mon-Fri; weekend rows post with the Monday update
measurements.surge_base_rates_measured: City-level, 5 categories, label = week > 1.25x trailing-8-week median: train 9.2-17.3%, eval 12.8-31.9%, holdout 9.3-20.9% per category (full counts in split_strategy); snapshot weekly_series_5cats.json
measurements.aggregation_cost_measured: Day-level group-by count series per category: 2 pages x <=1000 rows, 0.6-1.5 s/page measured from this coordinator (5-category full-range series = 10 requests, ~65 KB JSON). Sibling-service fetch-rate measurement on the same host: 49,947 rows in 27.2 s at 1000 rows/page with 2 small fields = 0.55 s/page; full 4.5M-row panel extraction DERIVED from that measured page rate: ~4,509 pages, ~40-75 min single-threaded (estimate, clearly labelled; worker construction must re-measure with the real field set). Bulk CSV via the Hub Download button exists but is unmeasured
measurements.related_items: Spatial twin 6e8f77f27ea84763abbc11023561a406 (excludes ~28% of rows - not used); deprecated predecessor 90711027d33940b5a06e96ad8a8f7ede frozen 2026-10-06 with publisher deprecation notice; 14 per-year historic item ids (2011-2024) extracted in notes.md for optional train-window extension
measurements.measured_on: 2026-10-29 via probe_c3.py from the hosted coordinator; commands and outputs in notes.md

review: All five discovery contracts have recorded evidence. (1) Redistribution: class A on the Council-approved Open Data Policy definition ('freely used, shared and built-on by anyone, anywhere, for any purpose') with disclaimer-only section-specific Terms of Use; residual no-named-licence caveat flagged for release-stage review. (2) Prediction timing: weekly Tuesday 06:00 SAST instant with measured same-day-absent / D-1-present availability, day-granular whole-day target window starting after the instant's day; the publisher's own revision policy (monthly reconciliation of completion fields and Suburb_Clean) is documented and its feature-exclusion consequences are recorded. (3) Target: created-count surge vs trailing median, source column CreatedOnDT excludable from shipped features (target-window rows must not ship - the abs-visitor-arrivals cross-row-join defect class is recorded as a construction constraint). (4) Split capacity: measured both-classes-present in train/eval/holdout for all 5 probed categories at city level (9-17% train surge base rate); suburb-level full counts are a worker prerequisite, recorded as such. (5) Not a mirror: NYC 311 forecasting is the named comparator (task family), StreetSignal ships only descriptive aggregates of this source; no ML-ready Cape Town C3 prediction task found.
next_action: READY (go). Handoff to advancement: worker-side extraction of the (created-date x category [x suburb]) panel from the live FeatureServer (full-panel fetch never on the coordinator), curated category list excluding hygiene types, Tuesday-06:00-SAST instant contract per notes.md, temporal splits per split_strategy, then the standing order construction -> full-worker qualification -> exact-byte acceptance -> reference/model scoring -> reporting. Construction success check: full-panel suburb x category counts with both classes in all three windows, blind cross-row-join probe negative (no shipped row exposes a scored week's outcome), known-event fixtures asserted (load-shedding-era No Power surges; named Cape Town storm week -> SEW surge).

novelty_check.theirs: The publisher ships only the raw notification table (no prediction task, no splits, no scored contract); StreetSignal (streetsignal.co.za) computes descriptive suburb aggregates from this same source (volume percentiles, resolution-time medians, complaint rates) with no forecasting; NYC 311 volume/resolution-time forecasting is abundant prior art on a different publisher, country, category ontology and regime drivers (named comparator for the task family).
novelty_check.ours: First scored, split, publication-instant-anchored prediction task on the City of Cape Town C3 service-request records: weekly surge exceedance (created-count > 1.25x trailing-8-week median) at a Tuesday 06:00 SAST instant, city-level primary with suburb x category expansion, on 4.5M unit-level notifications (Dec 2022-present) with the publisher's daily Mon-Fri update and monthly-reconciliation policy documented as part of the contract.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
